title: Planner-Actor-Reporter: An Embodied Agent Paradigm for Language Model Reasoning

defines.name: Planner-Actor-Reporter
defines.definition: A three-part embodied agent paradigm in which a language-model Planner issues instructions to an RL Actor and a Reporter feeds environmental observations back to the Planner.

problem: Reinforcement learning agents need large amounts of training data and generalize poorly, while language models can reason but cannot directly act in or observe embodied environments.
